newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's DEP seeks financial advisor for IPO plan.
newsitem.headline: Greece's DEP seeks financial advisor for IPO plan.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) is looking for a financial advisor to undertake the preparatory steps for its plan to float a 10 percent stake in an IPO.

"The Greek government has decided to proceed with the listing of up to 10 percent of the shares of the Public Petroleum Corporation on the Athens stock exchange," said a DEP advertisement in the Financial Times.

The invitation for expression of interest for its planned IPO said the financial advisor will co-ordinate organisational and corporate restructuring studies and engage auditors and legal advisors to assist in the preparation of the issue.
The advisor will also act as manager for the placement of the issue and consult DEP on all aspects of the IPO.
Bidding parties must express their interest by February 28.
